features.feature: FixedPrint Type is required. Matrix defaults to identity; H and V default to zero and express target-media percentages. Negative H/V and a margin-aware Matrix offset are discouraged with 'should', not reader rejection conditions. The transformed Rect becomes the smallest upright rectangle for appearance steps 2 and 3. A matrix B mapping the scaled/rotated page is cancelled. For n-up, each mark keeps its stated size and is placed as if its target media were the page's cell; tiling has a separate conditional rule for each output tile.
